top_signals.title: New Iran Sanctions Part of 'Piecemeal Strategy,' Says Rep. Gabe Amo
top_signals.summary: Representative Gabe Amo, a Rhode Island Democrat, called the US threat of sanctions against countries doing business with Iran more of the president's "piecemeal strategy" that's leaving the administration "grasping at straws." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Guggenheim Investments Says Affiliates May Buy Its Hard-Hit Loan
top_signals.summary: Guggenheim Investments, the asset-management arm of Mark Walter’s Guggenheim Partners, is telling lenders that affiliates may look to buy portions of a loan issued by its financing entity after the debt’s value collapsed in recent weeks.
